domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Prepare compatible fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite operands into a subtraction-ready form by normalizing whole/fraction/mixed-number expressions and, when needed, matching denominators so corresponding parts can be subtracted.
skills.merge_rationale: This continues the K=5 merge because both skills are preparatory transformations that make subtraction possible and belong to the same problem-solving phase.

skills.name: Execute subtraction and regrouping
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction of aligned whole and fractional parts, including borrowing across the whole-number part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
skills.merge_rationale: S04 is a conditional extension of S03: borrowing only arises during execution when direct subtraction of aligned parts fails. The prerequisite-like relationship and close coupling in worked solutions make this a meaningful merge at a coarser level.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or simplify zero-fraction results to a whole number or integer.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because simplification remains a distinct post-processing skill with different error patterns from answer composition.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: State the final result in an acceptable form by combining computed whole and fractional parts and omitting unnecessary zero parts.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because expressing the final answer is not identical to simplification; students may simplify correctly yet fail to present the result in proper final form.
